images.prompt: Photorealistic split-screen vertical fashion editorial image, divided exactly in half by a clean straight vertical seam at the center. The top 28 percent of the whole image is empty plain background on both halves, nothing in it. LEFT HALF: a flat lay product photograph viewed from directly above on a light pale grey plaster background, no person, items only in the lower 72 percent, neatly arranged top to bottom with small gaps: a light grey oversized double-breasted wool coat with a matching self-tie waist belt, a black leather shoulder bag with a silver metal buckle, a charcoal and light grey check pleated mini skirt, a pair of black sheer see-through tights laid flat, a pair of dark brown suede knee-high long boots with low heels, and small silver hoop earrings. RIGHT HALF: a full-body street style photo of a slim young Korean woman in her 20s wearing exactly the same items: the light grey oversized double-breasted coat worn open with the belt tied loosely at the waist, the check mini skirt visible under the coat, black sheer tights, dark brown suede knee-high boots, black leather shoulder bag on her shoulder, walking on a quiet Seoul sidewalk with bare winter trees and a beige stone building, only in the lower 72 percent. Headless body-only crop: the frame is cut at the collarbone, NO head, NO chin, NO mouth, NO hair visible at all. Identical items in both halves, realistic wool and suede textures, soft overcast winter daylight, 35mm film look. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no signs, no border.
